digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler Jira-family adapter seam (Cloud + Data Center backends)
propositions: Self-hosted Jira Data Center cannot be reconciled because it differs from Cloud on REST v2 wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity instead of accountId.

DC support must be added as an explicit jira_family sub-seam sharing one implementation of field/value maps, sanitizers, link vocabulary, probe classifier, rich-text codec, and identity model rather than forking a second adapter with cross-adapter private imports.

The local->Jira status and priority maps are already triplicated and drifted (only the ACLI copy omits deleted->Done, yielding an invalid Deleted transition), so the epic single-sources them and adopts deleted->Done as its one declared observable change.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) are loaded by path and must not be relocated; they are shared by dependency inversion (importing from jira_family) with _loader.py untouched.
The DC backend must require https for base_url unless allow_insecure is set (logging a warning), read the PAT only from the JIRA_PAT env var, and never disable TLS certificate verification.

The headline acceptance criterion requires operator-attested bidirectional reconciliation moving real data; the inbound half (a DC-created issue appearing locally with jira provenance) is proven, but the outbound half (a local edit appearing on the DC issue) is not yet proven.
